description: This Java class 'ScenarioTags' provides utility methods for classifying Cucumber test scenarios based on their tags, such as database-only, flaky, sequential, WIP, and whether they require a browser UI. It centralizes tag-based scenario classification logic for consistent usage across test hooks, step definitions, and runners.

classes.name: ScenarioTags
classes.description: Utility class for classifying Cucumber scenarios by tags, with static methods and constants.

methods.name: isDatabaseOnly
methods.description: Checks if the scenario is tagged only for database interaction, i.e., has a DB tag but no UI tags.

methods.name: isFlaky
methods.description: Checks if the scenario is marked as flaky via the @flaky tag.

methods.name: isSequential
methods.description: Checks if the scenario must run sequentially via the @sequential tag.

methods.name: isWip
methods.description: Checks if the scenario is marked as work-in-progress via the @wip tag.

methods.name: requiresBrowser
methods.description: Determines if the scenario requires a browser UI based on its tags, defaulting to true if scenario is null.
